title: Preparation of chemical competent E. coli cells with calcium chloride
author: Dennis DD Dienst
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qe4dtgw

steps.title: Prepare CCMB 80 Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 L of CCMB 80 buffer and filter sterilize.

substeps.instruction: Combine 10 mL of 1M K-Acetate stock, 11.8 g CaCl2 * H2O, 2 g MgCl2 * 6H2O, 4 g MnCl2 * 4H2O, and 100 mL glycerol.
Adjust pH to 6.4 using 0.1M HCl (work in a hood with goggles and gloves).
Add ddH2O to reach a final volume of 1 L.
Filter the buffer through a syringe filter (e.g., Acrodisc Syringe Filter, 0.2 µM Supor Membrane, Pall Life Science) while working in a Clean Bench.

steps.title: Prepare Seed Culture
steps.instruction: Prepare a seed culture of E. coli (e.g., DH5α).

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 5 mL of LB medium with seed cells in a test tube.

steps.title: Grow Primary Culture
steps.instruction: Scale up the culture to 250 mL in a Clean Bench.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 250 mL fresh LB medium with 5 mL of the overnight culture (1:50 ratio) in a 1L Erlenmeyer flask (closed with aluminium foil).
Incubate at 37 °C and >200 rpm until OD 600 reaches approximately 0.3.

steps.title: Harvest and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Concentrate and wash the cells using ice-cold CCMB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Cool down the centrifuge including inlets.
Transfer cultures to five sterile 50 mL Falcon tubes.
Gently resuspend each pellet in 16 mL ice-cold CCMB buffer.
Centrifuge again at 3000 *rcf and 4 °C for 10 min.
Gently resuspend each pellet in 2 mL ice-cold CCMB buffer.

steps.title: Aliquot and Store Competent Cells
steps.instruction: Dispense the cell suspension into tubes and freeze.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of the cell suspension into each 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube (keep tubes on ice).
Optionally, quick-freeze aliquots instantly in liquid nitrogen.
